pay_detail: Unpaid. A VolunTeen Scholarship is open to high school students with outstanding volunteer service.
notes: Two locations: Pickerington Main Library and Sycamore Plaza Library. Homework Help Center runs Monday to Thursday 3 to 6 p.m. in the school year.
name: Student Volunteers at Pickerington Public Library
what_you_do: Help keep the library neat, put books on shelves and set up events. You can help at the Homework Help Center and reward readers during Summer Reading. There is more to do too.
who_can_apply: Student volunteers must be at least 12 years old or in grades 7 to 12. You must have a Pickerington Public Library card and go to an orientation. You must keep a steady schedule of 2 to 6 hours a week for about 3 months or longer.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply on the volunteer page. Not all roles are open at all times.
how_to_apply: Click the Apply to Volunteer link on the volunteer page. Then go to an orientation. The Volunteer Coordinator runs it.
